dossier.weaponConcept: gel projector & axolotl tail unit (twin-tank mint-pink adhesive coolant cannon paired with a detachable cybernetic axolotl tail reservoir lotl-01)

lore.backstory: rogue chemical-materials engineer who turned industrial riot-control adhesive into a neon pastel art form. she modified her spinal coolant counter-balance into a semi-sentient cyber-axolotl tail that wiggles happily whenever an enemy squad gets glued to the floor~ uwu.
lore.syndicateRecord: glued an entire megacorp armored convoy to an elevated highway during rush hour and left a holographic smiley face on the windshield.
lore.psychProfile: playful troublemaker, loves glossy textures and chaotic splatter physics, treats tactical choke points like her personal slip-and-slide xo.
lore.combatQuote: “leave a prettier mess behind, hm? don’t struggle bestie, the resin only gets stickier~ :3”

dossier.identity: adhesive-gel breaker who glues a squad to the floor with slick strips, resin bubbles and a reactive coat~ uwu
dossier.selectionRationale: breaker because gel slows, roots and coats rather than bursting targets: a slow strip, a root bubble and residue stacks that slow and strip stability break formations and set up the squad's burst. the role is an owner decision (2026-11-07, hub#125); area slow and root keep her apart from hex's hacking and rook's piledriver.

iconFamily.subject: a bold axolotl tail curling around a single chunky resin bubble
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Nixie. Theme: neon resin. Subject: a bold axolotl tail curling around a single chunky resin bubble. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
